_comment: Ratchet baseline for check_no_app_names.py. These counts may only go DOWN. The target for all three is zero: content reaches it at extraction (stage 7), imports at the AppSpec seams (stage 4). `watched` is sticky on purpose, so an app that leaves the catalog is still scanned for leftovers.

content_files.because: Stage 4 (the AppSpec seams) moved 560 lines of four apps' business logic out of the platform module services/app_personas.py and the plaid branches out of routes/events.py + services/event_dispatch.py + services/stores.py, into seven app-owned modules (<app>_persona.py, finance_events.py, finance_store_adapter.py, notes_store_adapter.py). More app-source FILES in the repo, fewer platform files that know an app exists: imports 24->20 and literals 315->314 in the same change. All seven leave with their app at stage 7, which is where content goes to zero.
